tasks.title: Money module: module-level decimal.Context(prec=64) trapping InvalidOperation/Inexact/Overflow/DivisionByZero; parse_amount (32-char cap before ASCII-only anchored regex, > 0, quantize to 0.01), sum_by_currency, format_amount via format(d, 'f'); tests incl. '9'*32 never 500s and two '9'*29+'.99' rows total exactly

Error envelope and handlers: Q10 envelope models and envelope builder; handlers for RequestValidationError (422), StarletteHTTPException (any 4xx: not_found, method_not_allowed, ...), and a catch-all Exception handler (generic 500 envelope, logs only exception type and request path); fields built from loc/msg only, never input/ctx; extra_forbidden mapped to field 'body' / 'unknown field'; field capped at 64 chars; nothing about exc or body logged; register_error_handlers(app); tests against a throwaway FastAPI app (caplog asserts no input)

Expense schemas: ExpenseCreate (extra='forbid', strict str fields, amount via money.parse_amount, currency ^[A-Z]{3}$, category trimmed 1-50, date ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ + fromisoformat, note trimmed <=500 with empty -> null, reject C0/C1 control chars in category/note, fixed error messages), Expense and ExpenseList response models (amount/total as str), shared parse_iso_date; create empty app/expenses/__init__.py; unit tests

Request body size limit middleware: reject bodies over 16 KiB before JSON parsing (Content-Length check plus byte counting while streaming), 413 in the Q10 envelope with code 'payload_too_large'; tests against a throwaway app

SqliteExpenseStore and get_store dependency: ExpenseStore protocol, file pre-created with os.open(path, O_CREAT, 0o600) before first connect, WAL, user_version=1 schema with category_key (casefold) and indexes, per-call connections (timeout=5), parameterised SQL from fixed fragments only, ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC, rowid DESC; deps.py lazy store from EXPENSE_DB_PATH (no disk access at import); add *.db, *.db-wal, *.db-shm to .gitignore; store tests incl. 0600 mode, injection-string category, case-insensitive filter, inclusive date bounds, parallel adds

POST /expenses router and app wiring: APIRouter(prefix='/expenses') with create endpoint (201), export router from app/expenses/__init__.py, app/main.py gains include_router + register_error_handlers (title and /health unchanged); tests/conftest.py client fixture overriding get_store with a per-test tmp_path DB; API tests for create, required fields, validation 422s, Q14 body edge cases (null, wrong type, extra field, empty, malformed, non-object, JSON-number amount), duplicates, note absent from 422 bodies, /health 200 + title

GET /expenses list endpoint: repeated category -> 422, empty/whitespace params treated as absent, strict from/to parsing, from > to -> 422 in envelope, store.list, per-currency totals via money.sum_by_currency (map, {} when empty); API tests for list, totals, filters, open ranges, from == to, no matches, invalid filters, case-insensitive category, multi-currency, 0.10 + 0.20 == '0.30'

App hardening in main.py: TrustedHostMiddleware(allowed_hosts=['localhost', '127.0.0.1', 'testserver']), mount body-size limit middleware, no CORSMiddleware, debug=False; README.md run command binding 127.0.0.1 only with --no-access-log and the no-exposure-until-auth note; tests: foreign Host rejected, >16 KiB body -> 413 envelope, text/plain POST -> 422, forced 500 returns generic envelope and caplog has only type + path, note text absent from bodies and caplog

NFR tests: register 'perf' marker and addopts -m 'not perf' in pyproject.toml; perf test (10k seeded rows, 20 list calls, p95 < 200 ms); concurrency test (50 parallel creates -> 50 distinct IDs and a list of 50)
